provider: Queensland Government Department of Resources; public Gold Coast cadastral ArcGIS FeatureServer view
scope: Gold Coast cadastral polygon view; Queensland Government documentation describes the underlying DCDB/QSCF as statewide cadastral coverage. Exact-point response was verified, but citywide completeness was not tested.
schemaAndCrs: Layer metadata: esriGeometryPolygon, OBJECTID, LOTPLAN and other source fields; bounded query returned GeoJSON with outSR=4326. Native layer CRS details were inspected but retained sample is normalised to EPSG:4326.
nativeIdentity: LOTPLAN, evidenced by the layer field and returned values 5BUP4497, 00000BUP4497, and 6BUP4497. OBJECTID was observed as a fallback OID only; no synthetic row number was used.
requestOutcome: Verified-TLS public GET metadata, bounded ID-only probe, exact WUP-point GeoJSON query, and a coordinate-order diagnostic. Correct ArcGIS x,y request order (longitude,latitude) returned three polygons; the uncorrected latitude,longitude diagnostic returned zero and was not used as absence evidence. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields, or private records were accessed.
retainedProperties: Each of three full polygon features contains exactly {"id": "<LOTPLAN>"}; no raw source attribute set is retained.
unsafeDataPolicy: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, property-name, house-address, legal-description, or application fields were retained.
officialCustodyEvidence: Queensland Government Department of Resources ArcGIS metadata identifies the DCDB cadastral layer and its property-boundary purpose; Business Queensland documents public access through Queensland Globe, downloads and live web map services.
limits: A local public service hit is not proof of complete citywide coverage.
The exact WUP point hit three likely strata/building-unit-related parcel polygons; no semantic filtering was applied.
The source exposes additional fields that were intentionally not retained.
RuntimeReadiness remains held pending independent serial qualification.
uncertainty: LOTPLAN identity semantics and whether the view mixes base, strata, volumetric, or building-unit parcels need independent qualification. The response establishes a safe anonymous geometry route, not legal title truth or adapter admission.
